scientific_integrity: Analytic necessary and sufficient covering criterion proved; numerical finite grid and optimization checks provide diagnostics only.
scientific_limitations: Only parity-uniform radii on the fixed square lattice; not an unrestricted covering theorem. Equal-price optimization and the large-radius feasibility branch were known. Historical priority of unequal-price phase diagram remains provisional; independent review has not been performed.
title: An exact weighted-price transition in checkerboard lattice disk coverings
